messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> eng-sre: abnormal prefix/KV cache miss rate + KV shadow-read surge observed on prod-us-east-1. Error rate rising ~8% on generation endpoints. Auto-mitigation candidates: quota-trim, feature-disable(prefetch), prefix-bypass. Please ack and triage.

nina: acked. I'm oncall. pulling graphs now. seeing a 3x spike in prefix miss ratio; hot shards for a few tenants.

ryan: on the metrics — latency tail is also creeping. Looks correlated with increased prefetch traffic + some tenants doing heavy prefix fanout.

amy: customer impact: CS flagged 2 enterprise customers with elevated 5xx counts; they're seeing degraded chat completeness. cc @cs-jordan

cs-jordan: confirmed; customers reporting generation truncation. Need ETA for mitigation — they're asking for immediate rate control.

miguel: proposing live mitigations: 1) temporary per-tenant quota trim to 60% for noisy tenants, 2) disable prefetch job on prod globally (30m), 3) enable prefix bypass for correctness on suspected hotkeys (so reads go direct to KV without prefix heuristics).

nina: agree with order. I'll start with targeted quota trims first so we don't disrupt everyone. Can someone compile noisy tenant list?

mike: pulling top-20 tenants by request rate now. Will paste IDs in a sec.

mike: top offenders: tenant-23 (45k r/s), tenant-88 (12k r/s), tenant-101 (11k r/s), tenant-303 (9k r/s). Marking tenant-23 as priority.

ryan: I'll run the quota-trim for tenant-23 to 50% and tenant-88/101 to 70% as a fast rollback if needed. Command: ```
# internal mitigation API
curl -X POST https://internal-api/mitigations \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${MITIGATOR_TOKEN}' \ 
  -d '{"action":"set_quota","tenant":"tenant-23","qps":22500}'
```

nina: executing. Applying tenant-23 quota change now.

devops-bot: mitigation job started (id=mit-2319754321-01). Patch in flight to edge-routes.

nina: tenant-23 quota change completed. observability shows ~40% drop in tail latency for that shard. Error rate down ~2 points.

miguel: good. Next: disable prefetch globally for 30m to see if prefetch amplification is driving evictions. Command: ```
POST /internal/flags
{ "flag":"prefetch.enabled","value":false, "ttl":"30m" }
```

devops-bot: flag update queued; will roll to 100% in 45s.

eva: FYI, disabling prefetch may increase cold misses temporarily while cache warms; expect small latency bump on some paths. We'll monitor.

ryan: while that's rolling, I'm enabling prefix-bypass for suspected hotkeys (tenant-23 namespace). This makes reads go direct to KV to avoid correctness bypass logic causing additional misses. Command: ```
# route config
POST https://router.internal/configs/prefix-bypass \ 
  -d '{"tenant":"tenant-23","prefixes":["user_msgs_*"],"enabled":true}'
```

devops-bot: prefix-bypass applied for tenant-23 (change-id cb-8421).

nina: observation after all three changes: miss ratio on hot shard down ~60%, 5xxs for flagged customers dropped to baseline, global error-rate down ~5pts. Prefetch disable raised cold miss slightly but net customer impact is improved.

amy: sending an interim note to affected customers: "We applied emergency rate controls and cache routing adjustments to stabilize service. Expect improved completions; we're monitoring and will follow up with detailed postmortem."

cs-jordan: sent. customer replies are positive so far. Asking for ETA on full rollback or permanent mitigations.

miguel: next steps: 1) keep quota trims for 30m, 2) keep prefetch off for 30m while we watch, 3) run kv-cache telemetry to check eviction churn, 4) prepare a safe rollback plan.

nina: agreeing. I'm handing off active monitoring to oncall-miguel for the 30m window. I'll remain available if something regresses. Status update in 15m.

oncall-miguel: taking handoff. continuing watch. Posting periodic snapshots to #incidents.

devops-bot: mitigation job mit-2319754321-01 closed (success). Change cb-8421 still active. Flag prefetch=false TTL 30m.

ryan: quick note for postmortem: need to investigate prefetch amplification logic + prefix heuristic interaction. Hypothesis: prefetch concurrently evicting prefix cache entries under heavy fanout causing cascade of misses and KV shadow-reads.

amy: assigning follow-ups: (a) SRE: root-cause tracer (miguel, ryan) (b) Infra: prefetch rate limiter and flagging (mike, eva) (c) Product: customer comms + runbook updates (amy, cs-jordan).

nina: thanks team. I'll update the incident tracker and mark current state as "mitigated - monitoring". If stable after 30m we start gradual rollback: restore prefetch with stronger per-tenant caps and then restore quotas slowly.

cs-jordan: customers acknowledged. Will stay on the comms thread.

oncall-miguel: 15m check-in: metrics holding, no new noisy tenants. continuing watch.

nina: great. closing the live mitigation thread for now, will reopen if regressions observed. :white_check_mark:
